messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: Upcoming maintenance scheduled on 'control-plane-cache' in us-central1 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z - 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z. Potential overlap with customer-facing dedicated pools. /incident create (auto-generated)

maria_oncall: seeing this now. I have an existing handoff at 02:30 UTC — any way to shift the window?

alex_sre: quick context: this is a planned kernel upgrade on the host fleet. It's a rolling drain across AZs, expected short pod restarts but we may see transient 5xx for some dedicated inference endpoints if traffic routes to draining nodes.

kevin_infra: noted. Current plan is 5m drain per host, 30s restart, autoscale should absorb but there are two customers with pinned instances in us-central1 that don't autoscale: Cust-A and Cust-B.

maria_oncall: @kevin_infra can we delay the host drains for us-central1 by 1 hour? I can take the shift and handle on-call until 03:30 UTC. Need to avoid daytime customer impact.

kevin_infra: we can delay part of the fleet by 1 hour, but that splits the maintenance into two windows (us-central rolling starts 03:00 then other regions unchanged). Ops prefers single-window but can accommodate. Any objections?

sam_ops: operationally fine. but need comms alignment. Support & status will need copy for both sets.

jess_support: we'll prepare customer-facing copy. Can you confirm exact impact (timeouts vs 5xx vs latency spikes)? I want to avoid alarmist language.

alex_sre: likely <1% increased 5xx for pinned instances during the brief failover, ~150-300ms tail latency increase for some requests. No data plane changes. No change to stored data.

incident-bot: NOTE: Incident created: INC-2456789012-rcv (maintenance-overlap-check). Pager routed to oncall@maria_oncall.

maria_oncall: OK, plan: (1) Delay us-central1 window by +60m to avoid overlap with my handoff. (2) Draft statuspage + tenant email for Cust-A/B pre-notify. (3) Prepare rollback plan if <1% 5xx becomes >5%.

kevin_infra: ack. I'll update the schedule and tag the runbook. Runbook snippet:```
# maintenance runbook (short)
- Notify oncall and ops channel 1h before start
- Start rolling drain AZ-a -> AZ-b -> AZ-c
- Monitor 5xx and queue depth
- If 5xx > 5% for 5m -> pause rollout and rollback host to previous kernel
- If successful, mark complete and run post-checks
```

maria_oncall: draft status page (please review):
```
We will perform a rolling maintenance of control-plane cache nodes in US-CENTRAL on 2026-03-22 between 03:00-04:30 UTC. During the window some dedicated endpoints pinned to affected hosts may see brief errors or increased latency while traffic shifts. We expect most requests to continue to succeed.
- Impact: brief elevated 5xx rate for pinned dedicated pools (expected <1%); transient latency spikes for a subset of requests.
- Mitigation: automatic routing to healthy hosts, rollback plan if >5% 5xx.
We will update this page when maintenance begins and again when complete.
```

jess_support: LGTM. Draft tenant email for Cust-A/B (short):
"Hello — we will perform a rolling maintenance in us-central on 22 Mar 03:00-04:30 UTC. For pinned dedicated instances you may see short-lived errors or latency. If you have a critical job around that time let us know and we can coordinate. — Redwood Inference Ops"

maria_oncall: add the following internal note to the statuspage: "If impact observed, switch traffic to warmed standby pool and notify SEs immediately."

kevin_infra: confirmed. I'll also tag the dedicated pool owners so SEs can proactively reach customers. @jess_support can you prepare an individual customer DM template for Cust-A and Cust-B with a contact link?

jess_support: on it. I'll ping the SEs and draft DMs.

maria_oncall: monitoring checklist before start:
- Confirm synthetic checks green for US-CENTRAL (qps and latency)
- Confirm warm standby capacity present for pinned pools
- Validate alerting thresholds for 5xx and increased queue depth
- Confirm support rotation coverage for post-maint 2h

sam_ops: I'll run synthetic checks 15m before start and report back here.

incident-bot: ACTION: Remind in 60m to this channel and send email to subscribed tenants.

maria_oncall: final ops decision: delay us-central start to 03:00 UTC as above. I'm taking on-call coverage through 04:00 to handle any escalations. If anything spikes, we pause. Please avoid pushing unrelated deploys in us-central during 02:30-05:00 UTC.

kevin_infra: updated scheduler + runbook. tagging: #maintenance-schedule.

jess_support: customer DMs queued for review, will send 2h before the window and 30m before for Cust-A/B.

sam_ops: synthetics report 02:45 UTC: all green, qps nominal, tail lat within expected. Ready to proceed at 03:00.

maria_oncall: thanks. I'll post the "maintenance started" update to status page at 03:00 and keep this thread for live notes.

incident-bot: REMINDER: Maintenance window for INC-2456789012-rcv starts in 15m.

maria_oncall: 03:00: maintenance started. Minor blips seen on two pinned instances; 5xx peaked ~0.9% for 2m then trended down. Continuing rollout.

kevin_infra: rolling through AZ-b now. No host-level kernel failures. Autoscale absorbing non-pinned traffic.

jess_support: sent pre-window DM to Cust-A/Cust-B with SE contact. No immediate replies.

maria_oncall: 03:18: small spike to 1.8% 5xx for 4m on Cust-B routes. Paused rollout on remaining hosts and switched traffic to warmed standby. Notifying SEs.

kevin_infra: acknowledged. Rolling back last host upgrade (host-23) to previous kernel; monitoring.

incident-bot: UPDATE: INC-2456789012-rcv status changed: partial-impact, mitigation in progress.

maria_oncall: 03:27: rollback completed, 5xx dropped back to baseline. Resuming careful rollout with 10m pause between hosts and extra monitoring.

sam_ops: synthetics show tail latency normalizing.

maria_oncall: 03:50: maintenance complete for us-central1 subset. No further elevated errors.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: INC-2456789012-rcv — maintenance completed. Postmortem: required if >5% customer error rate or >15m outage for any customer.

maria_oncall: I'll draft a short post-maintenance summary and a customer note (completion).

jess_support: customer completion note ready: "Maintenance complete. If you see any residual issues, please reach out to your SE or support@redwood.ai". Sending to Cust-A/B now.

maria_oncall: closing loop: timeline + actions for postmortem doc:
- Timeline: start 03:00, pause 03:18, rollback 03:27, resume, complete 03:50
- Root cause: brief degraded failover under pinned instance routing; mitigated by rollback and standby routing
- Action items: add stricter pre-checks for pinned pools, add 10m quiesce between host upgrades for pools with pinned instances, update customer notification cadence

kevin_infra: will add the 10m quiesce and update runbook.

maria_oncall: thanks all. marking thread closed, will attach postmortem link when created. :white_check_mark:
